summary: PHASE 2 multi-list refactor — tested end-to-end. New backend test file test_sales_phase2.py: 17/18 pass. Existing test_sales_assistance.py regression: 22/23 pass (one pre-existing test has stale assertion against the new phase-2 CSV-upload field semantics — not a code bug). Frontend verified on kamal@thedigisparrow.com: Sales Assistant /app/sales loads new layout with [data-testid=sales-lists-sidebar] visible, [data-testid=sales-new-list-btn] visible, list rows render with Main list + existing 'saloon brampton' list, list-form-modal opens with name + description fields and 'Create list' button, hover-reveal rename/delete icons present on rows. Bounce detection integration test (synthetic DSN feed into _maybe_record_sales_bounce) confirms recipient.status flips to 'bounced' with bounce_reason, prospect.status flips to 'bounced', and the function returns True so the DSN is skipped from inbox persistence.

minor.issue: Legacy campaigns created before the phase-2 refactor are returned WITHOUT a 'list_ids' field. The spec mandates 'returns list_ids field on each campaign'. Fix: project list_ids default [] in list_campaigns (or run a migration). Frontend code should also defensively default to [] before mapping. test_sales_phase2.py::TestCampaignMultiList::test_list_campaigns_returns_list_ids fails for kamal because of one legacy campaign on the account.

Stale assertion in pre-existing test test_sales_assistance.py::TestProspects::test_csv_re_upload_overlap expects duplicates_skipped=2 but receives 1. Reason: phase-2 refactor changed semantics — duplicates_skipped now means 'already in THIS list' and merged_into_list is the new field for 'existed elsewhere, gained this list'. The test needs updating; the API behaviour is correct.

action_items: Fix GET /api/sales/campaigns to always return list_ids field — project list_ids default to [] for legacy campaigns OR run a one-time migration `update_many({list_ids: {$exists: false}}, {$set: {list_ids: []}})` inside _start_sales_sender startup hook (alongside the existing prospect migration).

Update test_sales_assistance.py::test_csv_re_upload_overlap to account for new merged_into_list field and corrected duplicates_skipped semantics (duplicates_skipped=1 + merged_into_list=1 for the bob case).
critical_code_review_comments: sales_routes.py delete_list line ~205: `delete_many({vendor_id, list_ids: [lid]})` correctly matches prospects whose list_ids array equals EXACTLY [lid] (Mongo exact-array match). Good — but be aware this only fires when the prospect has only ONE list AND it equals lid. If the array order had duplicates or extra empty strings (unlikely after normalization), they'd be missed. Acceptable.

sales_routes.py create_campaign line ~544: validates `valid_lists != len(target_list_ids)` but doesn't deduplicate `target_list_ids` first — if vendor passes the same list_id twice in payload, the count check fails. Minor: dedup with `target_list_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(payload.list_ids))`.

sales_routes.py update_prospect — does not validate that the new email matches _EMAIL_RE before checking for clash; but EmailStr in pydantic catches most. Confirmed via test: 422 fires before the manual check.

email_routes.py _maybe_record_sales_bounce line ~378: when a recent recipient is found, decrements campaign.sent_count by 1 AND increments failed_count by 1. Net effect on totals is correct, but the daily-series in analytics counts by status ∈ {sent, opened, failed} — once flipped to 'bounced' the recipient drops out of the series entirely. Bounced recipients are no longer visible in the daily chart. May confuse vendors who expect 'X bounced today'. Consider adding 'bounced' to the series status filter and a separate 'bounced' bucket per day.

email_routes.py _maybe_record_sales_bounce: returns True even when no recent campaign recipient is matched (just to skip inbox persistence). This means vendors using their inbox email for legitimate auto-replies from postmasters that *aren't* about a sales campaign will lose those messages from the inbox silently. Consider returning True only when a recipient IS matched, or when the From: matches mailer-daemon AND the body contains a clear bounce code.

rca_of_the_issue: Single backend failure (test_list_campaigns_returns_list_ids): root cause is that legacy campaign documents in MongoDB created before the phase-2 refactor lack the list_ids field — Pydantic CampaignIn now defaults list_ids=[] but only on create_campaign, not on read. Fix: backfill via _start_sales_sender startup migration OR project default in list_campaigns response. Reproduction: GET /api/sales/campaigns on kamal account → first 'items[i]' lacks 'list_ids' key. Mitigation: frontend defensive `(campaign.list_ids || []).map(...)` until backend backfill ships.
